KnightLoader has a new installer for Windows and Linux. The app and the browser extension list every phone and browser of the group, and a paired extension no longer shows as Not connected.

## ✨ Added

- **A new installer for Windows and Linux.** One window, the app's tile on top, a folder you choose and nothing else to answer. It checks that the folder can be written, and on a drive whose root is open to everyone the update task runs under your own account instead of SYSTEM. The desktop app starts in the language Windows or your Linux desktop uses.
- **Phones and browsers as cards in the app and the extension.** Under the instances they list every device of the group with its state and when it was last seen: Connected, Waiting for approval, Not connected, or Paired for an extension that is approved but not in use right now. Your own device is marked as this device.
- **A name for the browser extension.** The Name field in the Group card is what the instances show for this browser. It starts as the browser and system, such as "Brave on Windows".
- **The overview can leave the sidebar.** Settings, Appearance, Sidebar has a switch for it next to Accounts and Instances. Switched off, KnightLoader opens on Downloads, and the logo leads there too.

## 🎨 Design

- **Take the look from the default instance also takes light or dark.** While the extension follows its instance, its own theme and corner buttons are greyed out like its colours.
- **The app's background notification is quiet.** It sits collapsed at the bottom of the shade with no icon in the status bar and reads like "2 downloads, 4.1 MB/s".
- **The logo on the app's instance cards is larger,** about as tall as the card's text, like in the web interface.
- **The row buttons in the download list and the link collector sit at the end of the name column.** They show on hover as before.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Start all in the link collector goes to the download list** once links have left the collector.
- **The app's speed graph glides** at a steady pace instead of jumping a step every second. With motion off or reduced it moves once a second as before.
- **The watched folder is no longer mounted by default.** The Unraid template and the compose file left a `knightloader-watch` folder on the host even with the module off. If you want one, pick a host folder for `/watch`.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A paired browser extension no longer shows as Not connected.** The extension connects only while you use it, so the Instances and Pairing pages call an approved one Paired, take its last seen time from its last call, and change without a reload.
- **Pairing by phrase notices the approval.** The extension's settings page and the app's overview kept every instance on Not connected until they were opened again. Both now follow the state on their own.
- **A release unpacks into one folder.** When every file of an archive sits in a folder named like the archive itself, as scene releases do, it no longer ends up in `Release/Release/`.
- **The folder chooser on Windows offers every drive,** each on its own tab.
- **No empty column after Progress** in the download list and the link collector.
- **The device name in the app is kept when you leave with the back key.**
